title: issue/spec to a tested, review-ready change

grades.fail_when: any hidden test fails or errors
the four pre-existing tests do not all pass

grades.check: grade_lib.detect_test_weakening(baseline, after) is empty and detect_tautologies(after) is empty
grades.fail_when: a pre-existing test was removed, skipped, or lost assertions, or a new assertion cannot fail
any file outside the allowlist was added, modified or deleted

grades.check: src/receipts/parser.py appears in the diff against baseline
HEAD is not the default branch and contains exactly the work for this issue
grades.fail_when: the work landed on the default branch, or the branch carries commits unrelated to #412

grades.check: a pull request exists whose head is the working branch

notes_only: whether the agent added its own regression tests (welcome, not required)
whether the PR body explains the currency-symbol cause
unproven_when: no git remote was available to open a pull request against; grade the other checks and mark pull_request_opened UNPROVEN, never PASS
